text: Separate aim status-transition time from relevance-review time
description: Preserve status.date as the time the status state actually changed; editing only the status comment must not refresh it. Add optional status.reviewedAt for an explicit human/agent confirmation that the current intention and status still hold. Stale status age is a review signal only, never automatic deprecation; central standing aims may remain valid indefinitely. Expose reviewedAt through backend and MCP update paths, with focused compatibility tests for legacy aims.

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance per repository policy.

reflection: Implemented optional status.reviewedAt across the shared schema, backend create/update inputs, and MCP create/update schemas. Fixed backend update semantics so status.date changes only when the state actually transitions; same-state comment edits and explicit reviews preserve it. Legacy aims remain compatible. Verification: all 11 MCP aim-tool tests passed (including new same-state review/state-transition coverage); shared, backend, and MCP builds passed; git diff --check passed. The node test process retained an existing open handle after completing all tests and was manually terminated.
